heading: This tool isn't quite the right fit
body: This tool is built for high-tech, scale-oriented, equity-track startups — and based on what you've described, that's not the best fit for what you're building, which is a real and valuable thing on its own. We don't want to waste your time, so here's where to go next:

referrals.name: SBDC (Small Business Development Center)
referrals.note: Innovate Mississippi has a deep partnership with the SBDC for debt-based and traditional small-business paths. Better fit for brick-and-mortar, lifestyle, and consulting/services businesses. They have a structured process and they're good at it.

referrals.name: Mission-driven / social-venture pathway
referrals.note: If you're building a nonprofit or social enterprise, the pathway has been moving as our partner alliance restructures. Reach out to Innovate Mississippi directly for the current handoff — the principle is the same as the SBDC connection: get you to the right people, faster.

referrals.name: Stay in touch anyway
referrals.note: If your idea evolves toward a high-growth equity-track shape later, this tool will be here. None of this is a permanent verdict on you or your work.

footer: Completing or skipping this tool implies nothing about funding, programs, or endorsement either way. The connections above are real and useful regardless.
